theme_label_cn: 秋收黄主题 · 笛 · 丰谷灵境·守穗人
age_phrase: a slender young woman of about twenty
watermark: rice ears, golden sparrows and wheat waves
gradient: pale rice-yellow at the top to a deeper amber gold lower down
moon_halo: a hazy golden moon ringed by an amber halo
backdrop: silhouetted mountain ridges and a small tiered Chinese pavilion and granary standing behind the figure
hair_ornaments: small rice-ear sprigs and gold sparrow pins
robe_gradient: rice-wave yellow at the chest to saturated amber gold at the trailing hem
hold_action: {V:hold} a golden rice-ear jade flute "丰眠" raised before {p} lips
weapon_charm: a golden grain charm hanging from its lower end
expr_desc_1: {p} eyelids sit soft and half lowered with the pupils showing beneath them, and the corners of {p} mouth curve up into a gentle warm smile
expr_desc_2: {p} head is upright but {p} lids are lowered until {p} gaze rests down and away and {p} eyes are barely open, {p} lips closed and relaxed
expr_desc_3: {p} head tips a little back, {p} lids sit low and glossy, {p} lips part loosely and colour rises on both cheeks
expr_desc_4: {p} head turns three-quarters away from the reader and {p} chin lifts, while {p} eyes turn back toward the reader over {p} shoulder
profile: 性格：温厚勤恳，外柔内韧
喜好：晒谷、编麦穗、酿桂花酒、听风
couplet: 我本无心，只因你入梦，便留了心。
weapon_drawing: a small drawing of the golden rice-ear jade flute
background_text: 禾晏，丰谷灵境的守穗人。{T}以笛引雀，以穗为舟，渡人归仓，却从不入他人的丰年。看似温厚散漫、游戏人间，实则清醒坚韧，只肯在月下独酌。{T}在灵境中种满金稻，引万千金雀为伴，唯独等一个从不归仓的人。笛声起时，金穗覆野；笛声落处，秋收无痕。
signature: —— 一穗一雀一丰年，梦里不知身是客。
lighting: the warm golden sun behind thin cloud
palette: rice white, harvest yellow and amber gold
